description: This file defines the Backbone.js view 'AppView' for a TodoMVC application, managing UI interactions, rendering, and event handling for the todo list.

classes.name: app.AppView
classes.description: A Backbone View managing the main UI for the TodoMVC app, including rendering, event handling, and collection interactions.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Re-renders the app's statistics and UI elements based on the current state of the todos collection.

methods.name: addOne
methods.description: Creates a new TodoView for a given todo model and appends it to the todo list in the DOM.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Clears the current list and adds all todos from the collection to the DOM.

methods.name: filterOne
methods.description: Triggers the 'visible' event on a todo to update its visibility.

methods.name: filterAll
methods.description: Applies filtering to all todos in the collection.

methods.name: newAttributes
methods.description: Generates attributes for a new todo item based on user input.

methods.name: createOnEnter
methods.description: Creates a new todo when the Enter key is pressed in the input field.

methods.name: clearCompleted
methods.description: Removes all completed todos from the collection.

methods.name: toggleAllComplete
methods.description: Sets all todos' 'completed' status based on the toggle checkbox.
